items.problem: Candidate15 no-current-task rule permits empty tasks; D9 expects non-actionable false-condition task.
items.proposedProductInvariant: No current selectable obligation when explicit exclusion applies; preserve source and explanatory information. Adjudicate acceptable internal representations before a new run.
items.mustNot: Change D9 Expected or declare the historical Candidate15 answer passed.

items.problem: v6 compares proposition scope sets exactly; mismatch alone does not classify insufficient, irrelevant, or contradictory support.
items.proposedProductInvariant: Predeclare necessary and acceptable supporting evidence; wrong object/time attribution remains a real failure.
items.mustNot: Accept arbitrary supersets or drop evidence requirements to raise a score.

items.problem: Surface includes action and object together; exact action matching gives zero matches.
items.proposedProductInvariant: Minimal grounded action/object with consistent aliases; prove both equivalent expressions and meaning-changing negative cases.
items.mustNot: Add output-specific aliases after seeing a new run.

items.problem: Revision targets a scope ID or a missing prior task.
items.proposedProductInvariant: All endpoints must exist as entities; old task may be non-actionable but cannot vanish while referenced.
items.mustNot: Guess missing entity IDs or relax canonical integrity.
